blocks.html:
This method creates a fulfillment. It sends a request to the 
[Create Fulfillment](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#fulfillments\_postfulfillments)
API route.

children.name: location_id
children.description: The ID of the location the items are fulfilled from.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: The ID of the fulfillment provider used to handle the fulfillment.

children.name: delivery_address
children.description: The address to deliver items to.
